 IBPS RRB PO ADMIT CARD 2026 OUT 
 IBPS RRB PO Admit Card 2026 Out at ibps.in, Download Prelims Call Letter and Hall Ticket
 IBPS RRB PO Admit Card 2026 was released on 9 November 2026 at ibps.in. Candidates appearing for the Officers Scale-I Prelims Exam on 21 and 22 November 2026 can download their call letters using their registration number or roll number and password or date of birth.  IBPS RRB PO Admit Card 2026 has been released on 9 November 2026 by the Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS). Candidates who have applied for the CRP RRBs-XV recruitment can now download their Officers Scale-I Preliminary Examination call letter from the official website, ibps.in.
 The recruitment drive includes 4,256 vacancies for Officers Scale-I posts. The IBPS RRB PO Prelims Exam 2026 is scheduled to take place on 21 and 22 November 2026. Candidates can access their hall tickets by entering their registration number or roll number along with their password or date of birth.
 Candidates preparing for other banking recruitment examinations can also check the latest updates on IBPS Clerk Admit Card 2026 and IBPS PO Mains Admit Card 2026 .
 The call letter contains essential examination details, including the candidate's name, roll number, exam date, shift timing, reporting time and examination centre address. Candidates must download and print their admit cards before appearing for the examination.
 Read on to find the direct IBPS RRB PO Admit Card 2026 download link, instructions to access the call letter, details to verify and documents required on the examination day.
 IBPS RRB PO Admit Card 2026 Released
 IBPS has activated the download link for the IBPS RRB PO Prelims Call Letter 2026 on its official website. Candidates appearing for the Officers Scale-I preliminary examination can log in to the candidate portal and access their hall tickets.
 Candidates who want to understand the recruitment process, eligibility requirements and vacancy details can refer to the IBPS RRB Notification 2026 .
 The selection process for IBPS RRB PO recruitment includes three stages: Preliminary Examination, Main Examination and Interview. Candidates who qualify in the preliminary examination will be eligible to appear for the next stage.
 For details about the application process and registration requirements, candidates can also read the IBPS RRB Apply Online 2026 article.

 IBPS RRB PO Admit Card 2026 Download Link
 The IBPS RRB PO Admit Card 2026 download link is now active on the official website. Candidates can use their registration details to log in and download the preliminary examination call letter.
 Click Here to Download IBPS RRB PO Admit Card 2026 
 Candidates should ensure that the information entered during login matches their application details. After downloading the call letter, they should check all the particulars printed on it.
 How to Download IBPS RRB PO Call Letter 2026?
 Candidates can download their IBPS RRB PO Prelims Admit Card 2026 by following these steps:
 Visit the official IBPS website at www.ibps.in.
 Navigate to the CRP RRBs section available on the homepage.
 Select Common Recruitment Process for Regional Rural Banks Phase XV.
 Click on the link for the Online Preliminary Examination Call Letter for Officer Scale-I.
 Enter your Registration Number or Roll Number and Password or Date of Birth.
 Enter the displayed captcha code and click on Submit.
 Your IBPS RRB PO Admit Card 2026 will appear on the screen.
 Download the hall ticket and take a clear printout for examination day.
 Details Mentioned on IBPS RRB PO Hall Ticket 2026
 After downloading the admit card, candidates must carefully check all the information printed on it.
 The following details are generally mentioned on the call letter:
 Candidate's full name
 Candidate's photograph and signature
 Registration number and roll number
 Date of birth and category
 Name of the examination and post
 Examination date and shift
 Reporting time and examination timing
 Examination centre name and complete address
 Important examination-day instructions
 If candidates find any discrepancies in their personal details or examination information, they should contact IBPS through its official helpdesk immediately.
 Documents Required for IBPS RRB PO Exam 2026
 Candidates must carry the necessary documents to the examination centre. These generally include:
 Printed Admit Card: A clear printed copy of the IBPS RRB PO Admit Card 2026.
 Original Photo ID Proof: A valid government-issued identity document, such as an Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Voter ID, Passport or Driving Licence.
 Photocopy of Photo ID: A photocopy of the same identity document, as required by the examination instructions.
 Passport-Size Photographs: Recent photographs, preferably matching the one uploaded during the application process, as specified in the call letter.
 Candidates should carefully read the instructions printed on their admit cards to confirm the permitted documents and other examination-day requirements.
 Unable to Download IBPS RRB PO Admit Card 2026? Here's What to Do
 Some candidates may experience technical difficulties while accessing their IBPS RRB PO Prelims Call Letter. These issues may occur due to incorrect login credentials, browser problems or heavy website traffic.
 Candidates can try the following solutions:
 Check Login Credentials: Make sure the registration number or roll number and password are entered correctly.
 Use Date of Birth: If the password is unavailable, try logging in using the date of birth in the prescribed format.
 Use the Forgot Password Option: Reset the password through the available option if login details are not working.
 Clear Browser Cache: Clear browsing history and cached data before trying again.
 Change Browser or Device: Access the official website using another browser or device if the problem continues.
 Try Again Later: If the website is slow due to heavy traffic, wait for some time and attempt to download the call letter again.
 Candidates should ensure that they download their admit cards before the examination date and verify all the details in advance.
